title: basable routing.yaml
description: The message topology of a basable nanoservice project: which nanoservice handles and sends which message, and what each message answers with. Read by basable-messenger-gen at build.

error_type.description: The error type every typed and error response carries (a Rust type path).

ctx_type.description: The request context type every handler receives (a Rust type path).

uses.description: `use` items emitted at the top of both generated crates, so message names resolve.

name.description: The nanoservice's name: its crate, its router field, and (in PascalCase) its component type.

handles.description: The messages this nanoservice handles, in the order fan-outs call it.

sends.description: The messages this nanoservice may send; its sender exposes exactly these.

message.description: The message type (a Rust type path, resolved through `messenger.rust.uses`).

response.description: Absent: a void fan-out (`()`, 0..N handlers). `error`: a sequential fail-fast fan-out (`Result<(), Error>`). Any other value: the typed response of a strict 1:1 request (`Result<T, Error>`, exactly one handler).
